question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.

The ________ in my shoelace created a lot of trouble.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3)**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"knot"** means an **interlacing, looping, or fastening together of material, typically rope or string.** (गांठ)

 
 
• **Example:** He tied a** knot **in the rope to secure the boat.
 
 
 
• **"Knot"** refers to a complication or problem that can cause inconvenience or trouble. (गांठ)
 
 
• **Example:** The** knot** in my shoelace created a lot of trouble.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Not** (नहीं): Used to express negation, denial, or refusal.

 
 
• **Example:** I do **not** like apples.
 
 
 
• **Naught** (शून्य): Nothing or zero.
 
 
• **Example:** All his efforts came to **naught.**
 
 
 
• **Nought** (शून्य): Zero; the digit 0.
 
 
• **Example:** The number 100 has two **noughts.**
